The '''DR-45 "Dragoon" Cavalry Blaster''' was a convertible [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbine]] that was sold by [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.]] for 1,900 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. The [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] was based on Merr-Sonn's [[DD6 blaster pistol/Legends|DD6 blaster pistol]] and could be used in pistol or carbine form.<ref name="Stay on Target" />
